summary.text: Blaine Wilhour is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 110th District, serving since January 2019, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Wilhour's legislature biography describes a farmer and business owner, born March 10, 1982, and a graduate of St. Elmo High School.
It says Wilhour served in the Illinois Army National Guard from 1999 to 2005 and is a former member of the Fayette County Board.
